description: Lightweight 3 Hole Face Mask provides unbeatable complete coverage and protection of the head, neck, and face, and has three holes for your mouth, nose, and eyes. Its 100% polyester material makes the facemask lightweight and breathable, perfect for tactical situations, and comfortable to wear under helmets and other tactical gear. Due to its lightweight features, the facemask can be worn in the summer and the winter. One size fits most.
